simple.meaning: שִׁיבָה (shîybâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “residence.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H7871. shibah I. [ שִׁיבָה ] noun feminine sojourn (= ֗֗֗ יְשִׁיבָה according to Thes) — only בְּשִׁיבָתוֺ 2 Samuel 19:83 during his sojourn ; but read בְּשִׁבָתּוֺ see יָשַׁב Qal 2. — II. שִׁיבָךְ see below שׁוב .

occurrences.englishText: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”
